questions.text:
Zn + 2CH3COOH -> (CH3COO)2Zn + H2
उपर्युक्त अभिक्रिया है :
questions.text_english:
Zn + 2CH3COOH -> (CH3COO)2Zn + H2
The above reaction is a:
questions.solution: Option B is correct because Zinc displaces hydrogen from acetic acid to form zinc acetate and hydrogen gas. This is a classic single displacement reaction.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है क्योंकि जिंक, एसिटिक अम्ल से हाइड्रोजन को विस्थापित कर जिंक एसीटेट और हाइड्रोजन गैस बनाता है, जो एक विस्थापन अभिक्रिया है।

questions.text: किसी लवण का जलीय विलयन नीले लिटमस को लाल कर देता है । इस लवण को निम्नलिखित में से किसके बीच अभिक्रिया से प्राप्त किया जा सकता है ?
questions.text_english: An aqueous solution of a salt turns blue litmus to red. The salt could be the one obtained by the reaction of:
questions.solution: Option D is correct. A salt that turns blue litmus red is an acidic salt. Acidic salts are formed by the neutralization of a strong acid (like HCl) and a weak base (like NH4OH).
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है। जो लवण नीले लिटमस को लाल करता है वह अम्लीय होता है, जो प्रबल अम्ल (HCl) और दुर्बल क्षारक (NH4OH) से बनता है।

questions.text: चार अलग-अलग बीकरों में भरे चार विलयनों ग्लूकोस, ऐल्कोहॉल, हाइड्रोक्लोरिक अम्ल और सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल, को एक-एक करके किसी विद्युत परिपथ से संयोजित किया गया है जिसमें एक बल्ब भी जुड़ा है । विद्युत धारा प्रवाहित करने पर जिनमें बल्ब जलेगा वह विलयन हैं :
questions.text_english: Four solutions, namely glucose, alcohol, hydrochloric acid and sulphuric acid filled in four separate beakers are connected one by one in an electric circuit with a bulb. The solutions in which the bulb will glow when current is passed are:
questions.solution: Option D is correct. Hydrochloric acid and sulphuric acid dissociate into ions in aqueous solution, which conduct electricity and make the bulb glow. Glucose and alcohol do not dissociate into ions.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प D सही है। हाइड्रोक्लोरिक और सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल आयनों में टूट जाते हैं और विद्युत का चालन करते हैं, जबकि ग्लूकोस और ऐल्कोहॉल नहीं।

questions.text: स्वतंत्र अवस्था और संयुक्त अवस्था दोनों में पाई जाने वाली धातुएँ हैं :
questions.text_english: The metals which are found in both free state as well as combined state are:
questions.solution: Option C is correct. Copper and silver are found in nature in both the free state and combined state (as sulphides or oxides).
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। कॉपर और सिल्वर प्रकृति में स्वतंत्र अवस्था और संयुक्त अवस्था (सल्फाइड या ऑक्साइड) दोनों में पाए जाते हैं।

questions.text: बेन्ज़ीन (C6H6) के अणु में उपस्थित एकल आबन्ध और द्विआबन्ध की संख्या क्रमशः है :
questions.text_english: The number of single and double bonds present in a molecule of benzene (C6H6) respectively, are:
questions.solution: Option B is correct. The benzene molecule contains 6 C-H single bonds, 3 C-C single bonds (total 9 single bonds), and 3 C=C double bonds in a planar hexagonal ring.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। बेन्ज़ीन में 6 C-H एकल आबन्ध, 3 C-C एकल आबन्ध (कुल 9) और 3 C=C द्विआबन्ध होते हैं।

questions.text: मानवों में, जब पाचन की प्रक्रिया पूर्ण हो जाती है तब (i) प्रोटीन, (ii) कार्बोहाइड्रेट, और (iii) वसा अंतिमतः परिवर्तित हो जाते हैं क्रमशः :
questions.text_english: In human beings, when the process of digestion is completed, the (i) proteins, (ii) carbohydrates, and (iii) fats are respectively finally converted into :

options.A: (i) ऐमीनो अम्ल, (ii) ग्लूकोस और (iii) वसीय अम्ल में
options.B: (i) ऐमीनो अम्ल, (ii) ग्लूकोस, (iii) वसीय अम्ल और ग्लिसरॉल में
options.C: (i) ग्लूकोस, (ii) वसीय अम्ल और ग्लिसरॉल, (iii) ऐमीनो अम्ल में
options.D: (i) शर्करा, (ii) ऐमीनो अम्ल, (iii) वसीय अम्ल और ग्लिसरॉल में

options_english.A: (i) Amino acids, (ii) glucose and (iii) fatty acids
options_english.B: (i) Amino acids, (ii) glucose, (iii) fatty acids and glycerol
options_english.C: (i) Glucose, (ii) fatty acids and glycerol, (iii) amino acids
options_english.D: (i) Sugars, (ii) amino acids, (iii) fatty acids and glycerol

questions.solution: Option B is correct. Complete digestion converts complex proteins to simple amino acids, carbohydrates into glucose, and fats into fatty acids and glycerol.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। पाचन के बाद प्रोटीन ऐमीनो अम्ल में, कार्बोहाइड्रेट ग्लूकोस में तथा वसा वसीय अम्ल एवं ग्लिसरॉल में बदल जाते हैं।

questions.text: पत्तियों के मुरझाने का कारण है वृद्धि संदमक करने वाला पादप हॉर्मोन जिसे कहते हैं :
questions.text_english: A plant growth inhibitor hormone which causes wilting of leaves is called:
questions.solution: Option C is correct. Abscisic acid is a plant growth inhibitor that promotes the aging and wilting (falling) of leaves.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। ऐब्सिसिक अम्ल एक वृद्धि संदमक हॉर्मोन है जो पत्तियों के मुरझाने के लिए उत्तरदायी है।

questions.text: कायिक प्रवर्धन की विधि द्वारा उगाए जा सकने वाले पादप हैं :
questions.text_english: The plants that can be raised by the method of vegetative propagation are:
questions.solution: Option A is correct. Sugarcane, roses, and grapes are commonly grown using vegetative propagation methods like stem cuttings.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है। गन्ना, गुलाब और अंगूर को तने की कलम जैसी कायिक प्रवर्धन विधियों द्वारा उगाया जाता है।

questions.text: बीज के अंकुरण के समय खाद्य के स्रोत वाला बीज का भाग है :
questions.text_english: The part of seed which is a source of food during germination of seed is :
questions.solution: Option A is correct. The cotyledon stores food for the growing embryo until it can perform photosynthesis.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है। बीजपत्र अंकुरण के समय बढ़ते हुए भ्रूण के लिए भोजन का संचय करते हैं।

questions.text: नर युग्मक और मादा युग्मक के संलयन द्वारा युग्मनज बनता है। किसी मानव के युग्मनज में गुणसूत्रों की संख्या होती है :
questions.text_english: A zygote is formed by the fusion of a male gamete and a female gamete. The number of chromosomes in the zygote of a human is :
questions.solution: Option C is correct. Human gametes have 23 chromosomes each. Upon fusion, the zygote receives a total of 46 chromosomes (23 pairs), restoring the diploid number.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। मानव युग्मकों में 23 गुणसूत्र होते हैं, इसलिए संलयन से बने युग्मनज में 46 गुणसूत्र होते हैं।

questions.text: काँच और जल के निरपेक्ष अपवर्तनांक क्रमशः 3/2 और 4/3 हैं। यदि काँच में प्रकाश की चाल 2 x 10^8 m/s है, तो जल में प्रकाश की चाल है :
questions.text_english: Absolute refractive index of glass and water is 3/2 and 4/3 respectively. If the speed of light in glass is 2 x 10^8 m/s, the speed of light in water is :
questions.solution: Option A is correct. The speed of light in a vacuum c = ng * vg = (3/2) * (210^8) = 310^8 m/s. Therefore, velocity in water vw = c / nw = (310^8) / (4/3) = (9/4)10^8 m/s.

questions.text: जब श्वेत प्रकाश का कोई किरण-पुंज किसी ऐसे क्षेत्र से गुज़रता है जहाँ धूल के अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म कण विद्यमान हैं, तो उस क्षेत्र में मुख्य रूप से प्रकीर्णित होने वाला प्रकाश का वर्ण (रंग) है :
questions.text_english: When a beam of white light passes through a region having very fine dust particles, the colour of light mainly scattered in that region is :
questions.solution: Option C is correct. According to Rayleigh's law of scattering, shorter wavelengths (like blue) scatter much more intensely than longer wavelengths when hitting fine particles.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। रेले प्रकीर्णन के अनुसार, सूक्ष्म कण कम तरंगदैर्ध्य वाले प्रकाश (जैसे नीला) का अधिक प्रकीर्णन करते हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित प्रतिरोधकों के संयोजनों पर विचार कीजिए : इनमें तुल्यांक प्रतिरोध 1Ω वाला/वाले संयोजन है/हैं :
questions.text_english: Consider the following combinations of resistors : The combinations having equivalent resistance 1 Ω is/are:
questions.image_description: Four electrical circuit diagrams showing resistor combinations: I: Two 2Ω resistors in parallel. II: Three 3Ω resistors in parallel. III: Two parallel branches, one with 2Ω and 4Ω in series, another with 3Ω and 3Ω in series. IV: Two 0.5Ω resistors in parallel.
questions.solution: Option C is correct. Equivalent resistance of combination I is 2/2 = 1 Ω. For combination II, it is 3/3 = 1 Ω. For III it is 6/2 = 3 Ω. For IV it is 0.5/2 = 0.25 Ω. Thus, I and II have 1 Ω resistance.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। संयोजन I का तुल्य प्रतिरोध 2/2 = 1 Ω है। संयोजन II का 3/3 = 1 Ω है। III का 3 Ω और IV का 0.25 Ω है। अतः I और II का 1 Ω है।

questions.text: 20 Ω प्रतिरोध की कोई विद्युत इस्तरी 5 A धारा लेती है । इस इस्तरी में 30 सेकण्ड में उत्पन्न ऊष्मा है :
questions.text_english: An electric iron of resistance 20 Ω draws a current of 5 A. The heat developed in the iron in 30 seconds is :
questions.solution: Option A is correct. Using Joule's law of heating: H = I²Rt. Substituting the values: H = (5)² * 20 * 30 = 25 * 20 * 30 = 15000 Joules.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है। जूल के ऊष्मन नियम H = I²Rt का उपयोग करने पर: H = (5)² * 20 * 30 = 25 * 20 * 30 = 15000 जूल।

questions.text: कोई आयताकार पाश ABCD जिससे धारा I प्रवाहित हो रही है किसी सीधे चालक XY के निकट इस प्रकार स्थित है कि चालक पाश की भुजा AB के समान्तर है तथा पाश के ही तल में है । यदि आरेख में दर्शाए अनुसार चालक में स्थायी धारा I स्थापित कर दी जाए, तो चालक XY :
questions.text_english: A rectangular loop ABCD carrying a current I is situated near a straight conductor XY, such that the conductor is parallel to the side AB of the loop and is in the plane of the loop. If a steady current I is established in the conductor as shown, the conductor XY will

options.B: पाश की भुजा AB की ओर गति करेगा ।
options.C: पाश की भुजा AB से दूर की ओर गति करेगा ।
options.D: अपने अक्ष के परितः घूर्णन करेगा ।

options_english.B: move towards the side AB of the loop.
options_english.C: move away from the side AB of the loop.

questions.image_description: A straight vertical conductor XY with current flowing upwards, placed near a rectangular loop ABCD. Side AB is closest to XY and parallel to it. Current in the loop flows clockwise, so current in side AB flows upwards.
questions.solution: Option B is correct. Two parallel conductors carrying current in the same direction attract each other. Since the current in wire XY and side AB of the loop are both flowing in the same (upward) direction, they will attract.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। दो समान्तर चालक जिनमें समान दिशा में धारा प्रवाहित हो रही है, वे एक-दूसरे को आकर्षित करते हैं। चालक XY और भुजा AB में धारा की दिशा समान है, इसलिए यह आकर्षित होगा।

questions.text:
नीचे कुछ अपशिष्ट दिए गए हैं :
(i) बगीचे का अपशिष्ट
(ii) बॉल प्वॉइन्ट पेन के रिफिल
(iii) दवाइयों की खाली काँच की बोतल
(iv) फलों और सब्ज़ियों के छिलके
(v) पुरानी सूती कमीज़
इनमें से अजैव-निम्नीकरणीय अपशिष्ट हैं :
questions.text_english:
Some wastes are given below :
(i) Garden waste
(ii) Ball point pen refills
(iii) Empty medicine bottles made of glass
(iv) Peels of fruits and vegetables
(v) Old cotton shirt
The non-biodegradable wastes among these are:
questions.solution: Option B is correct. Non-biodegradable wastes cannot be broken down by biological processes. Pen refills (plastic) and glass bottles fall into this category. The rest are organic and biodegradable.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प B सही है। अजैव-निम्नीकरणीय अपशिष्टों को जैविक प्रक्रियाओं द्वारा तोड़ा नहीं जा सकता है। प्लास्टिक रिफिल और काँच की बोतलें इस श्रेणी में आती हैं।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : धातु के सल्फाइड अयस्कों से अयस्क को बिना भर्जन किए धातु निष्कर्षित नहीं किया जा सकता है ।
कारण (R) : भर्जन से सल्फाइड अयस्क सीधे ही धातु में परिवर्तित हो जाते हैं ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The extraction of metals from their sulphide ores cannot take place without roasting of the ore.
Reason (R): Roasting converts sulphide ores directly into metals.
questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 17 से 20 के लिए, दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को कारण (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। सही उत्तर कोड (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: For Questions number 17 to 20, two statements are given one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु कारण (R) ग़लत है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Option C is correct. Assertion is true because it is easier to extract metals from their oxides, so sulphide ores are first roasted to convert them to oxides. Reason is false because roasting converts the sulphide ore to an oxide, not directly into the metal.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प C सही है। अभिकथन सही है क्योंकि धातुओं का उनके ऑक्साइड से निष्कर्षण आसान है, इसलिए सल्फाइड अयस्कों का भर्जन किया जाता है। कारण गलत है क्योंकि भर्जन से सल्फाइड अयस्क ऑक्साइड में बदलते हैं, सीधे धातु में नहीं।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : मानव हृदय में अलिन्द की अपेक्षा निलय की पेशीय भित्ति मोटी होती है ।
कारण (R) : निलय को शरीर के विभिन्न अंगों में रुधिर को पंप करना होता है ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): In the human heart ventricles have thicker muscular walls than atria.
Reason (R): Ventricles have to pump the blood into various organs.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Option A is correct. Both the assertion and reason are true. Ventricles must pump blood out to the entire body at high pressure, which requires thick, strong muscular walls, explaining why they are thicker than atria.
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प A सही है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं और कारण सही व्याख्या करता है, क्योंकि निलय को उच्च दाब पर शरीर के सभी अंगों में रक्त भेजना होता है जिसके लिए मोटी भित्तियों की आवश्यकता होती है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएँ कभी भी एक-दूसरे का प्रतिच्छेदन नहीं करती हैं ।
कारण (R) : यदि वह प्रतिच्छेदन करें, तो प्रतिच्छेदन बिन्दु पर दिक्सूची की सुई दो दिशाओं की ओर संकेत करेगी जो संभव नहीं है ।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Magnetic field lines never intersect each other.
Reason (R): If they intersect, then at the point of intersection, the compass needle would point towards two directions, which is not possible.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Option A is correct. Both the assertion and reason are correct statements. The reason perfectly explains the assertion because a compass needle can only show one direction of the net magnetic field at any given point.

questions.text: ज्वाला परीक्षण द्वारा संतृप्त और असंतृप्त हाइड्रोकार्बन के बीच विभेदन कीजिए । संतृप्त हाइड्रोकार्बन के दहन की अभिक्रिया के उत्पादों की सूची बनाइए ।
questions.text_english: Distinguish between a saturated and an unsaturated hydrocarbon by flame test. List the products of combustion reaction of a saturated hydrocarbon.

key_points: Saturated hydrocarbons burn with a clean blue flame.
Unsaturated hydrocarbons burn with a yellow sooty flame.
Products of combustion: Carbon dioxide (CO2), Water (H2O), Heat, and Light.

questions.solution: In a flame test, saturated hydrocarbons generally burn with a clean blue flame due to complete combustion. Unsaturated hydrocarbons burn with a yellow, sooty flame due to incomplete combustion of their higher carbon content. The products of combustion of a saturated hydrocarbon are carbon dioxide, water, heat, and light.
questions.solution_hindi: ज्वाला परीक्षण में, संतृप्त हाइड्रोकार्बन स्वच्छ नीली ज्वाला के साथ जलते हैं, जबकि असंतृप्त हाइड्रोकार्बन पीली और धुएँ वाली ज्वाला के साथ जलते हैं। संतृप्त हाइड्रोकार्बन के दहन से कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड, जल, ऊष्मा और प्रकाश उत्पन्न होते हैं।

questions.text_english:
(a) We need to water the soil in plants on a regular basis. But it ultimately reaches the leaves of the plant. Explain how this takes place.
OR
(b) Name the type of nutrition exhibited by Amoeba. Explain how food is taken in and digested by this organism.

key_points: Option A: Water is absorbed by roots.
It moves upward through xylem tissue driven by transpiration pull.
Option B: Holozoic nutrition.
Amoeba uses pseudopodia to engulf food forming a food vacuole.
Digestive enzymes break down food inside the vacuole.

questions.solution:
(a) The roots absorb water from the soil through osmosis. This water is then transported upwards to the leaves through the xylem tissue. This upward movement is primarily driven by transpiration pull, created by the loss of water vapour from the leaves.
OR
(b) Amoeba exhibits holozoic nutrition. It extends temporary finger-like projections called pseudopodia to engulf the food particle, forming a food vacuole. Inside the vacuole, complex food is broken down into simpler substances by digestive enzymes, which then diffuse into the cytoplasm.
questions.solution_hindi:
(a) जड़ें परासरण द्वारा मृदा से जल अवशोषित करती हैं। वाष्पोत्सर्जन कर्षण के कारण यह जल जाइलम ऊतकों के माध्यम से ऊपर पत्तियों तक पहुँच जाता है।
अथवा
(b) अमीबा प्राणीसम (Holozoic) पोषण दर्शाता है। यह पादाभ (pseudopodia) की सहायता से भोजन को घेरकर खाद्य रिक्तिका बनाता है। रिक्तिका के भीतर एंजाइम जटिल भोजन को सरल पदार्थों में तोड़कर पचाते हैं।

questions.text_english: The survival of a species is promoted through creation of variations. Illustrate with an example.

key_points: Variations help organisms adapt to changing environments.
Example: A population of bacteria in temperate water.
If water temperature increases due to global warming, most bacteria die.
A few variants resistant to heat will survive and reproduce.

questions.solution: Variations provide better adaptability to organisms, helping them survive drastic environmental changes. For example, in a population of bacteria living in temperate water, if the water temperature suddenly rises due to global warming, most bacteria would die. However, a few variants that are resistant to heat would survive, reproduce, and save the species from extinction.
questions.solution_hindi: विभिन्नताएँ जीवों को बदलते पर्यावरण के प्रति अनुकूलन में मदद करती हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, यदि जल का तापमान ग्लोबल वार्मिंग के कारण अचानक बढ़ जाए, तो अधिकांश जीवाणु मर जाएँगे। लेकिन गर्मी के प्रति प्रतिरोधी कुछ भिन्न जीवाणु जीवित रहेंगे और प्रजाति को विलुप्त होने से बचा लेंगे।

questions.text: जरा-दूरदृष्टिता से पीड़ित किसी व्यक्ति को द्विफोकसी लेंसों की आवश्यकता है। यदि उसे - 4.0 डाइऑप्टर और + 2.0 डाइऑप्टर क्षमता के दो लेंसों की आवश्यकता हो, तो इन दोनों में से कौन-सा लेंस उसकी दूर की दृष्टि (निकट-दृष्टि दोष) का संशोधन करेगा और इसकी फोकस दूरी क्या है ?
questions.text_english: A person suffering from presbyopia needs bifocal lens. If he needs two lens of power - 4.0 dioptre and + 2.0 dioptre, which one of these two lenses is for the correction of distant vision and what is its focal length ?

key_points: The concave lens with negative power (-4.0 D) is used for distant vision.
Focal length formula: f = 1/P

questions.solution: For correcting distant vision (myopia), a concave lens is required, which has a negative power. Therefore, the lens with a power of -4.0 D is used for distant vision. Its focal length is calculated as: f = 1/P = 1/-4.0 = -0.25 meters, or -25 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: दूर दृष्टि (निकट-दृष्टि दोष) के संशोधन के लिए अवतल लेंस का उपयोग होता है जिसकी क्षमता ऋणात्मक होती है। अतः -4.0 D का लेंस दूर दृष्टि के लिए है। इसकी फोकस दूरी f = 1/P = 1/-4.0 = -0.25 मीटर या -25 सेमी होगी।

questions.text: दो तारों A और B जो समान पदार्थ, समान लम्बाई और क्रमशः व्यास 0.2 mm और 0.3 mm के हैं, को एक-एक करके किसी परिपथ में संयोजित किया गया है। इन दोनों में से कौन-सा एक तार परिपथ में धारा के प्रवाह में अधिक प्रतिरोध उत्पन्न करेगा ? अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Two wires A and B of same material, having same lengths and diameters 0.2 mm and 0.3 mm respectively, are connected one by one in a circuit. Which one of these two wires will offer more resistance to the flow of current in the circuit? Justify your answer.

key_points: Wire A (0.2 mm) will offer more resistance.
Resistance is inversely proportional to the cross-sectional area (R ∝ 1/A).
A smaller diameter means a smaller area, leading to higher resistance.

questions.solution: Wire A will offer more resistance. Resistance of a wire is inversely proportional to its cross-sectional area (and therefore inversely proportional to the square of its diameter). Since wire A has a smaller diameter (0.2 mm) compared to wire B (0.3 mm), it has a smaller area and hence higher resistance.
questions.solution_hindi: तार A अधिक प्रतिरोध उत्पन्न करेगा। किसी तार का प्रतिरोध उसके अनुप्रस्थ काट के क्षेत्रफल के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होता है (R ∝ 1/A)। क्योंकि तार A का व्यास (0.2 mm) कम है, इसका क्षेत्रफल कम होगा और इसलिए प्रतिरोध अधिक होगा।

key_points: Common name: Plaster of Paris.
Chemical name: Calcium sulphate hemihydrate.
Preparation: Heating Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) at 373 K.

questions.solution: The common name of CaSO4.1/2H2O is Plaster of Paris, and its chemical name is Calcium sulphate hemihydrate. It is prepared by heating gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O) at 373 K, causing it to lose water molecules. When it reacts with water, it sets into a hard solid mass again. Equation: CaSO4.1/2H2O + 1 1/2 H2O -> CaSO4.2H2O (Gypsum).
questions.solution_hindi: CaSO4.1/2H2O का सामान्य नाम प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस है और रासायनिक नाम कैल्शियम सल्फेट अर्धहाइड्रेट (हेमीहाइड्रेट) है। इसे जिप्सम (CaSO4.2H2O) को 373 K पर गर्म करके बनाया जाता है। जल के साथ अभिक्रिया: CaSO4.1/2H2O + 1 1/2 H2O -> CaSO4.2H2O (जिप्सम)।

questions.text: एथेनॉल का एथेनॉइक अम्ल में परिवर्तन उपचयन (ऑक्सीकरण) अभिक्रिया क्यों है ? इस परिवर्तन में उपयोग होने वाले उपचायक का नाम लिखिए । इस उपचयन अभिक्रिया का रासायनिक समीकरण लिखिए । यह अभिक्रिया उस अभिक्रिया से किस प्रकार भिन्न है जिसमें एथेनॉल का ऑक्सीजन की उपस्थिति में दहन होता है ?
questions.text_english: Why is the conversion of ethanol to ethanoic acid an oxidation reaction? Name the oxidising agent used in this conversion. Write chemical equation for this oxidation reaction. How is this reaction different from the reaction in which ethanol burns in the presence of oxygen?

key_points: It is oxidation because oxygen is added and hydrogen is removed.
Oxidising agent: Alkaline KMnO4 or Acidified K2Cr2O7.
Equation: CH3CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3COOH + H2O.
Difference: Oxidation retains the carbon skeleton; combustion breaks it completely into CO2 and H2O.

questions.solution: The conversion of ethanol to ethanoic acid is an oxidation reaction because oxygen is added to the molecule and hydrogen is removed. The oxidising agent used is alkaline Potassium Permanganate (KMnO4) or acidified Potassium Dichromate (K2Cr2O7). Equation: CH3CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3COOH + H2O. This reaction is different from combustion because combustion is complete oxidation, which completely breaks down the carbon skeleton to produce carbon dioxide, water, and heat, whereas this is controlled partial oxidation.
questions.solution_hindi: एथेनॉल का एथेनॉइक अम्ल में परिवर्तन उपचयन है क्योंकि इसमें ऑक्सीजन जुड़ता है और हाइड्रोजन हटता है। उपचायक क्षारीय KMnO4 या अम्लीकृत K2Cr2O7 है। समीकरण: CH3CH2OH + 2[O] -> CH3COOH + H2O। यह दहन से भिन्न है क्योंकि दहन में पूर्ण ऑक्सीकरण होकर CO2 और जल बनते हैं, जबकि यह नियंत्रित आंशिक उपचयन है।

questions.text_english:
(a) Explain with the help of a labelled diagram, the process of reproduction in Hydra by budding. Name the cells used for reproduction in this process.
OR
(b) List two roles of each of the following in human reproductive system:
(i) Seminal vesicles and prostate gland
(ii) Oviduct
(iii) Testis

key_points: Option A: Hydra develops an outgrowth (bud) due to repeated cell division.
The bud develops tentacles and detaches when fully mature.
Regenerative cells are used.
Option B: (i) Provide nutrition to sperms, make transport easier (fluid medium).
(ii) Transfer egg from ovary to uterus, site of fertilization.
(iii) Produce sperms, secrete testosterone.

questions.solution:
(a) In Hydra, reproduction by budding begins when an outgrowth or bud forms at a specific site due to repeated cell division. These buds develop into tiny individuals with mouth and tentacles. Once fully mature, they detach from the parent body to live independently. Regenerative cells are involved in this process.
OR
(b) (i) Seminal vesicles and prostate gland add their secretions to provide nutrition to sperms and create a fluid medium for their easy transport. (ii) Oviducts (Fallopian tubes) transport the egg from the ovary to the uterus and serve as the site for fertilization. (iii) Testes produce male gametes (sperms) and secrete the male hormone testosterone.
questions.solution_hindi:
(a) हाइड्रा में पुनर्जनन कोशिकाओं के बार-बार विभाजन से एक मुकुल (bud) निकलता है। यह मुकुल विकसित होकर स्पर्शक बनाता है और पूर्ण परिपक्व होने पर जनक से अलग हो जाता है। इसमें पुनर्जनन कोशिकाओं का उपयोग होता है।
अथवा

questions.text: प्रभावी लक्षणों और अप्रभावी लक्षणों के बीच दो अन्तरों की सूची बनाइए । मेंडल के पीले बीज (YY) और हरे बीज (yy) के मटर के पौधों के बीच संकरण कराने पर F2 संतति के मटर के पौधों में पीले बीज वाले पौधों की प्रतिशतता क्या थी ?
questions.text_english: List two differences between dominant traits and recessive traits. What percentage of pea plants in the F2 generation were with yellow seeds in Mendel's cross between the pea plants having yellow (YY) and green coloured (yy) seeds ?

key_points: Dominant traits express in both homozygous and heterozygous conditions.
Recessive traits express only in homozygous conditions.
In a monohybrid cross of YY and yy, F1 are all Yy (Yellow).
In F2 generation, phenotypic ratio is 3:1. Percentage of yellow seeds is 75%.

questions.solution: Dominant traits are characteristics that express themselves in both homozygous (YY) and heterozygous (Yy) conditions. Recessive traits express themselves only when present in a homozygous (yy) condition. In Mendel's monohybrid cross between yellow (YY) and green (yy) seeded plants, the F1 generation is all yellow (Yy). When F1 is self-pollinated, the F2 generation produces yellow and green seeds in a 3:1 ratio. Therefore, the percentage of yellow-seeded plants in the F2 generation was 75%.
questions.solution_hindi: प्रभावी लक्षण वे हैं जो समयुग्मजी (YY) और विषमयुग्मजी (Yy) दोनों अवस्थाओं में स्वयं को व्यक्त करते हैं। अप्रभावी लक्षण केवल समयुग्मजी (yy) अवस्था में व्यक्त होते हैं। मेंडल के संकरण में F2 पीढ़ी में 3:1 के अनुपात में पीले और हरे बीज प्राप्त हुए। अतः पीले बीज वाले पौधों का प्रतिशत 75% था।

questions.text: मानव नेत्र की समंजन क्षमता की परिभाषा दीजिए । जब हम किसी बिम्ब की नेत्र से दूरी में वृद्धि करते हैं, तो नेत्र में प्रतिबिम्ब दूरी का क्या होता है ? इस प्रकरण में मानव नेत्र के उस भाग का नाम और भूमिका की व्याख्या कीजिए जो इसके लिए उत्तरदायी है ।
questions.text_english: Define the term power of accommodation of human eye. What happens to the image distance in the eye when we increase the distance of an object from the eye? Name and explain the role of the part of human eye responsible for it in this case.

key_points: Power of accommodation is the ability of the eye lens to adjust its focal length.
The image distance remains constant (on the retina).
Ciliary muscles are responsible.
They relax to make the lens thinner, increasing focal length for distant objects.

questions.solution: The power of accommodation is the ability of the human eye lens to adjust its focal length to clearly focus both near and distant objects on the retina. When we increase the object's distance from the eye, the image distance inside the eye remains constant because the image must always form on the retina. The ciliary muscles are responsible for this. To see a distant object clearly, the ciliary muscles relax, causing the eye lens to become thinner, which increases its focal length.
questions.solution_hindi: नेत्र लेंस की अपनी फोकस दूरी को समायोजित करने की क्षमता को समंजन क्षमता कहते हैं। जब हम वस्तु की दूरी बढ़ाते हैं, तो नेत्र में प्रतिबिम्ब दूरी समान (रेटिना पर) रहती है। इसके लिए पक्ष्माभी पेशियाँ (ciliary muscles) उत्तरदायी होती हैं। जब वस्तु दूर होती है, तो पेशियाँ शिथिल हो जाती हैं जिससे लेंस पतला हो जाता है और उसकी फोकस दूरी बढ़ जाती है।

(a) Why do iron filings arrange in a particular pattern ?
(b) What does the crowding of iron filings at the ends of the magnet indicate?

questions.solution: (a) Iron filings arrange in a pattern because they experience magnetic force exerted by the bar magnet. questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 34 से 36 दीर्घ उत्तरीय प्रश्न हैं ।
questions.instruction_line_english: Questions no. 34 to 36 are long answer type questions.

key_points: Option A:
A chemical reaction is a process transforming reactants into new products.
Color change activity: Iron nail in copper sulphate solution (blue to green).
Temp change activity: Adding water to quicklime (exothermic).
Option B:
Decomposition: one reactant breaks into multiple products.
Electrolysis of water uses electrical energy to break H2O into H2 and O2.
Silver bromide breakdown uses light energy.
CaO formation is decomposition (CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2). Ca(OH)2 formation is combination (CaO + H2O -> Ca(OH)2).

questions.solution:
(a) A chemical reaction is a process where substances undergo chemical changes to form new substances with different properties. Activity for colour change: When an iron nail is placed in a blue copper sulphate solution, iron displaces copper, turning the solution pale green (iron sulphate). Activity for temperature change: When water is added to quicklime (calcium oxide) in a beaker, it reacts vigorously to form slaked lime, releasing a large amount of heat, making the beaker hot to touch.
OR
(b) (i) A decomposition reaction is one where a single reactant breaks down into two or more simpler products. (I) In the electrolysis of water, a single compound (H2O) breaks down into H2 and O2 gases using electrical energy. (II) Silver bromide breaks down into silver and bromine gas upon absorbing light energy. Both are decomposition reactions. (ii) The formation of calcium oxide is a decomposition reaction where limestone is heated: CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2. Conversely, the formation of calcium hydroxide is a combination reaction where two substances combine: CaO + H2O -> Ca(OH)2. Thus, decomposition and combination are opposite reaction types.

questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Define a reflex arc. Why have reflex arcs evolved in animals? Trace the sequence of events which occur, when you suddenly touch a hot object.
(ii) Name the part of nervous system which helps in communication between the central nervous system and other parts of the body. What are the two components of this system?
OR
(b) (i) Leaves of 'chhui-mui' plant begin to fold up and droop in response to a stimulus. Name the stimulus and write the cause for such a rapid movement. Is there any growth involved in the movement ?
(ii) Define geotropism in plants. What is meant by positive and negative geotropism? Give one example of each type.

key_points: Option A: Reflex arc is the neural pathway of a reflex action.
Evolved for fast response to protect the body without waiting for brain processing.
Sequence: Receptors in skin -> sensory neuron -> spinal cord -> motor neuron -> effector muscle.
PNS handles communication. Components: cranial and spinal nerves.
Option B: Stimulus is touch (Thigmonasty).
Caused by changes in turgor pressure (water amount) in cells.
No growth is involved.
Geotropism: directional growth response to gravity. Positive (downwards) = Roots. Negative (upwards) = Shoots.

questions.solution:
(a) (i) A reflex arc is the neural pathway that controls a reflex action. Reflex arcs have evolved in animals to provide an immediate and automatic response to dangerous stimuli, bypassing the slower thinking process of the brain to prevent tissue damage. Sequence: Heat is detected by thermoreceptors in the skin -> sensory neuron carries impulse to the spinal cord -> relay neuron transfers it to a motor neuron -> motor neuron carries impulse to the effector (muscle in the arm), causing it to contract and withdraw the hand. (ii) The Peripheral Nervous System (PNS) facilitates this communication. Its two components are cranial nerves and spinal nerves.
OR
(b) (i) The stimulus for the 'chhui-mui' (Touch-me-not) plant is touch. This rapid movement is caused by a sudden change in turgor pressure; the cells at the base of the leaves rapidly lose water and collapse. There is no growth involved in this movement, it is purely a nastic movement. (ii) Geotropism is the directional growth movement of a plant part in response to gravity. Positive geotropism is growth towards gravity (e.g., roots growing downwards into the soil). Negative geotropism is growth away from gravity (e.g., shoots growing upwards).

(a) The variation of image distance (v) with object distance (u) for a convex lens is given in the following observation table. Analyse it and answer the questions that follow :
(i) Without calculation, find the focal length of the convex lens. Justify your answer.
(ii) Which observation is not correct? Why? Draw ray diagram to find the position of the image formed for this position of the object.
(iii) Find the approximate value of magnification for u = -30 cm.
OR
(b) (i) Define principal axis of a lens. Draw a ray diagram to show what happens when a ray of light parallel to the principal axis of a concave lens passes through it.
(ii) The focal length of a concave lens is 20 cm. At what distance from the lens should a 5 cm tall object be placed so that its image is formed at a distance of 15 cm from the lens ? Also calculate the size of the image formed.

key_points: Option A: f = 25 cm (since at u=50, v=50, indicating object is at 2f).
Observation 6 is incorrect. For u=-15 (inside focal length), image must be virtual and negative.
Option B: Principal axis is the line passing through centers of curvature and optical center.
Concave lens problem: f = -20 cm, v = -15 cm.
Using lens formula 1/f = 1/v - 1/u, u = -60 cm.
Magnification m = v/u = 1/4. Image size = +1.25 cm.

questions.image_description: A table with 6 rows. Columns are S.No, Object distance (u) cm, Image distance (v) cm. Rows: 1) -150, +30. 2) -75, +37.5. 3) -50, +50. 4) -37.5, +75. 5) -30, +150. 6) -15, +37.5. (Note: in original text, some negative signs on 'u' might be missing typographically but implied).
questions.solution:
(a) (i) The focal length is 25 cm. From observation 3, when u = 50 cm, v = 50 cm. For a convex lens, this occurs when the object is at 2f. So, 2f = 50 cm, hence f = +25 cm. (ii) Observation 6 (u = -15 cm, v = +37.5 cm) is incorrect. Since u = 15 cm is less than the focal length (25 cm), the object is between the optical centre and focus. The image formed should be virtual, erect, and on the same side (v should be negative). (iii) For u = -30 cm (Observation 5), v = +150 cm. Magnification m = v/u = 150 / -30 = -5.
OR
(b) (i) The principal axis of a lens is an imaginary straight line passing through the two centres of curvature and the optical centre of the lens. A ray parallel to it will diverge and appear to come from the principal focus. (ii) For a concave lens, f = -20 cm. Since it forms virtual images, v = -15 cm. Lens formula: 1/f = 1/v - 1/u => 1/-20 = 1/-15 - 1/u. Solving this, 1/u = 1/-15 + 1/20 = -1/60, so u = -60 cm. Magnification m = v/u = -15 / -60 = 1/4. Size of image h' = m × h = (1/4) × 5 cm = +1.25 cm.

key_points: (i) Nitric acid is a strong oxidizing agent.

Products: Metal nitrate, water, and nitrogen oxides.

sub_questions.solution:
(i) Hydrogen gas is not evolved because dilute nitric acid is a strong oxidizing agent. As soon as hydrogen gas is produced, nitric acid oxidizes it to water and itself gets reduced to nitrogen oxides. The ultimate products are metal nitrate, water, and oxides of nitrogen (like NO or NO2).
OR
(ii) The reactivity of metals is decided based on displacement reactions. To check which is more reactive, we place metal X in the aqueous salt solution of metal Y. If metal X displaces metal Y from its salt solution, X is more reactive. If no reaction occurs, Y is more reactive.

(ii) 16 Ω resistor has higher potential difference.
